PERSONALISED AESTHETIC & SKIN CARE

Personalised Aesthetic Medicine. Beautifully, Scientifically.

Medical-grade aesthetic care, tailored to your skin, your concerns and your long-term goals.

Book a Consultation Explore Treatments
9987802355 Consultation by appointment

Personalised Care

Every plan is tailored to your skin, your history and your goals — never a one-size-fits-all routine.

Evidence-Based Approach

Treatments are chosen on current medical evidence for your specific condition.

Advanced Aesthetics

From medical-grade skin treatments to advanced aesthetic procedures — thoughtfully selected for your individual needs.

Patient-Centred

Clear consultation, honest guidance and care that respects your time and comfort.

MEET YOUR PHYSICIAN

Dr. Rishita Ray

Founder & Aesthetic Physician, Ma Lumière

I believe good aesthetic care begins with understanding the skin — not simply choosing a procedure.

I am Dr. Rishita Ray, an Aesthetic Physician with a background in modern aesthetic medicine and a special interest in skin health, acne, acne scarring and pigmentation.

My approach brings together medical understanding, clinical assessment and aesthetic precision. From managing persistent skin concerns to planning advanced aesthetic treatments, I believe every face and every skin type deserves an individualised approach.

At Ma Lumière, I founded the clinic around a simple philosophy: diagnosis first, procedures second.

I believe in understanding the underlying concern, setting realistic expectations and recommending treatments based on individual needs — never procedures for the sake of procedures.

Whether the goal is healthier skin, improved texture, scar management or subtle facial rejuvenation, my focus is on thoughtful treatment planning, natural-looking outcomes and care that evolves with you.

Because good aesthetic medicine isn’t about changing who you are. It’s about helping you feel comfortable in your own skin.

Meet the Doctor

What we treat

Aesthetic Medicine, thoughtfully done

Medical and aesthetic care across the conditions that matter to you.

  • Acne & Acne Scars
  • Hair Loss & Hair Thinning
  • Healthy Aging & Skin Rejuvenation
  • Injectables & Facial Contouring
  • Laser Hair Reduction
  • Laser Tattoo Removal
  • Other Concerns We Treat
  • Pigmentation & Uneven Skin Tone

Hair Loss & Hair Thinning

Hair Loss & Hair Thinning

Clinical assessment and personalised plans for thinning, shedding and hair-fall concerns.

Learn more

Pre-Wedding Skin Preparation

Pre-Wedding Skin Preparation

A calm, scheduled skin plan so you walk into your day with confidence — not last-minute fixes.

Learn more

Acne & Acne Scars

Acne & Acne Scars

Evidence-led acne care and considered scar treatment — for active breakouts and their after-effects.

Learn more

Laser Hair Reduction

Laser Hair Reduction

Clinic-grade laser for long-term hair reduction across face and body, planned around your skin type.

Learn more

Pigmentation & Uneven Skin Tone

Pigmentation & Uneven Skin Tone

Targeted care for dark spots, sun damage and uneven tone — built around your skin, not a trend.

Learn more

Laser Tattoo Removal

Laser Tattoo Removal

Q-switched laser treatment to fade unwanted tattoos, spaced safely across the clearing cycle.

Learn more

Healthy Aging & Skin Rejuvenation

Healthy Aging & Skin Rejuvenation

A long-view approach to skin health — resilience, texture and radiance at every age.

Learn more

Injectables & Facial Contouring

Injectables & Facial Contouring

Subtle, anatomy-led injectable work — softening, balancing and contouring without looking done.

Learn more

Other Concerns We Treat

Texture-focused care to refine the look of enlarged pores and keep congestion under control.

Learn more

View all treatments

The journey

Care that follows a considered path

01

Consultation

A private discussion of your concerns, history and expectations.

02

Skin Assessment

A careful clinical examination of your skin and its needs.

03

Personalised Plan

A plan designed for your skin type, concerns and lifestyle.

04

Treatment

Medical or aesthetic treatment carried out with care and precision.

05

Follow-up

Reviewing progress and refining your plan as your skin responds.

Our philosophy

Your skin deserves more than a routine. It deserves a plan.

Beautiful skin begins with understanding — exactly how your skin behaves, what it has been through, and what it needs going forward. At Ma Lumière, every journey starts with a conversation and a careful assessment, then develops into a plan built around you.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Online booking is now open — choose a treatment, pick a date and time, and confirm your consultation in a few steps. You can still call or WhatsApp the clinic, contact details are on this page and in the footer.

Ma Lumière is on the first floor of Vasudev Sky High, Kanakia Road, Beverly Park, Mira Road East, 401105. It is a short drive from Bhayander East, Bhayander West and Kashimira. The contact page includes a Google Maps link for directions.

Yes. A large share of our patients travel from Bhayander East, Bhayander West and Kashimira. Consultations are by appointment, so we recommend calling ahead and allowing extra time during peak traffic on the Mira Road–Bhayander stretch.

We review your skin, medical history and previous treatments, then discuss what is likely to help and what is not. You will receive a clear plan, an estimate of sessions and the cost before deciding whether to proceed. There is no obligation to book a treatment on the day.

Cost depends on the treatment, the area treated and the number of sessions required. A quotation is given after your consultation, once the plan is clear. We do not recommend packages before your skin has been assessed.

Yes. Laser hair reduction can be planned for both men and women on the face, underarms, legs, back, chest and other areas. Suitability depends on hair colour, skin type and medical history, so a consultation and patch test come first.
